== Build notes ==
Magazine dest 23 October 2026. Page 70 from Internet Archive item arcane-magazine_202508 (PDF leaf 70). Transcription from the opened scan. Crop is the green Star Wars CCG review box; Cliff Ramshaw's AD&D reviews on the same page are omitted.

== Possibly faulty data ==
Wikipedia's Star Wars Customizable Card Game Reception section says Butcher gave the game 10/10. The printed score box is 5/10. Dest used the scan.

== Marginal cuts ==
The same issue's Despatches column called the game average and advertised a 36-pack booster draw via CMA Hay-on-Wye. Not dested. Printed unmatched closing parenthesis after "if he's killed)" kept.
